design.description: Categorical, zero-padded, stable ID. Prefix encodes type: CMP->component, IF->interface, ADR->adr, DIA->diagram. An optional uppercase category infix is allowed (e.g. CMP-AUTH-004).
design.name: id

design.description: Design-artifact category.
design.name: type

design.description: Short human-readable title (matches the kebab-case used in the filename).
design.name: title

design.description: One clear statement of what this element is.
design.name: description

design.description: Upstream traceability: requirement IDs (FR-/NFR-/CON-/BR-/UC-) this element satisfies. May be empty. Existence is resolved by the cross-artifact validator (STO-102), not this schema.
design.name: traces_from

design.description: Downstream traceability to ADRs, diagrams, code, and tests. Any key may be omitted or empty.
design.name: traces_to

design.description: Lifecycle status. IDs are never re-used; set status to obsolete instead of deleting.
design.name: status

design.description: Confidence level for human-in-the-loop triage (STO-138).
design.name: confidence

design.description: Creation date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
design.name: created_at

design.description: RESERVED (agile planning scope). Present-but-optional; mirrors the requirement schema.
design.name: scope

design.description: RESERVED. Parent scope ID, or null. Present-but-optional.
design.name: parent_scope

design.description: The single clear purpose of the unit.
design.name: responsibility

design.description: Whether the unit is inside the system boundary or an external system modelled as a component (C4).
design.name: boundary

design.description: The interface contracts this component consumes. IF- IDs only; may be empty. Existence is resolved by the design validator.
design.name: depends_on

design.description: The single component that provides this contract. Exactly one CMP- ID.
design.name: provider

design.description: The operations this contract exposes, at architecture altitude (name + summary + interaction; no payload schemas).
design.name: operations

design.description: How this contract can fail. An interface that does not say how it fails is a gap; at least one mode is required.
design.name: error_modes

design.description: MADR decision status. Distinct from `status`, which is the artifact lifecycle.
design.name: decision_status

design.description: The options weighed. Never fabricated: when a second option cannot be recovered from the recorded decision, no ADR is emitted at all.
design.name: considered_options

design.description: The option taken. Absent while the decision is still proposed.
design.name: chosen_option

design.description: C4 level. Determines the Mermaid header directive: context->C4Context, container->C4Container, component->C4Component.
design.name: level

design.description: The container key whose internals this view depicts. Present only on level: component.
design.name: container

qa.description: Categorical, zero-padded, stable ID. Optional uppercase category infix allowed (e.g. TS-PERF-004).
qa.name: id

qa.description: The level this strategy item operates at. Drives grouping in the rendered qa-strategy.md.
qa.name: test_level

qa.description: Derived from the quality-attribute scenarios and requirements this item covers. Orders the rendered prioritisation section.
qa.name: risk_level

qa.description: Why this risk level. Mandatory at every level, including low: an unexplained 'low' is the one a reader cannot check.
qa.name: risk_rationale

qa.description: Whether CI actually checks this. STO-104 reads it to tell a real DoD gate from one a human must remember.
qa.name: enforcement

qa.description: The requirement and design IDs this item covers. The QA->upstream edge is stored here and nowhere else; validate_traceability.py walks it backwards.
qa.name: traces_from

qa.description: Downstream references to real test and source files, filled in when code exists. Empty through M3 by design.
qa.name: traces_to

qa.description: RESERVED (agile planning scope). Present-but-optional; mirrors the requirement schema.
qa.name: scope

qa.description: RESERVED. Parent scope ID, or null. Present-but-optional.
qa.name: parent_scope

requirements.description: Categorical, zero-padded, stable ID. Prefix encodes type: FR->functional, NFR->non_functional, CON->constraint, BR->business_rule, UC->use_case. An optional uppercase category infix is allowed (e.g. FR-ORDER-014).
requirements.name: id

requirements.description: Short human-readable title (matches the kebab-case used in the filename).
requirements.name: title

requirements.description: For functional requirements: an EARS-phrased statement. For NFRs/constraints/etc.: a clear single statement of the requirement.
requirements.name: description

requirements.description: Volere mandatory rationale: the WHY behind this requirement.
requirements.name: rationale

requirements.description: Volere mandatory fit criterion: a measurable test oracle for the requirement.
requirements.name: fit_criterion

requirements.description: EARS sentence pattern. Required for functional requirements only; omitted for other types.
requirements.name: ears_pattern

requirements.description: Lifecycle status. IDs are never re-used; set status to obsolete instead of deleting.
requirements.name: status

requirements.description: Upstream traceability: IDs of higher-tier requirements this one derives from. May be empty for top-tier (business) requirements.
requirements.name: traces_from

requirements.description: Downstream traceability mapping to design, tests, and code artifacts. Any of the three keys may be omitted or empty.
requirements.name: traces_to

requirements.description: RESERVED. Parent scope ID, or null. Present-but-optional.
requirements.name: parent_scope
